01 · ABOUT

Terrain that reads as real.

I create terrain in Blender, everything from small environmental pieces to massive open world maps. Every project is built with real geological logic: proper erosion, layered rock formations, natural flow.

Deliverables come in Mesh or Smooth Terrain, whichever your project needs. When the terrain is suited for it, I'll also put together a full Blender render with cinematic lighting and atmosphere.

Note: I don't provide 3D vegetation, foliage, horizontal caves, or holes.
